title: A colorful Steinitz theorem with different centers
summary: We prove a colorful quantitative Steinitz theorem in which the color classes may have different centers. If the convex hull of each of $2d$ sets in $\R^d$ contains a translate of the Euclidean unit ball, then a rainbow convex hull contains a ball of radius $(3d)^{-2d^2}$ whose center belongs to the convex hull of the given centers. The main ingredient is an exact result for translates of a segment, proved by a lifting and a topological colorful Helly theorem.
